description: Create a Flux 2 task on RunAPI (remix image). Returns a task id, status, and output URLs.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio. Declared type: string. Known values: "1:1", "4:3", "3:4", "16:9", "9:16", "3:2", "2:3", "auto".

callback_url.description: Webhook URL for async notifications. Declared type: string.

enable_safety_checker.description: Enable the safety checker. Declared type: boolean.

model.description: RunAPI model slug for this model line.

output_count.description: Number of images to generate. Declared type: integer. Known values: 1.

output_resolution.description: Output resolution. Declared type: string. Known values: "1k", "2k".

prompt.description: Image editing instruction. Declared type: string.

source_image_urls.description: Public source image URLs. Declared type: array.

wait.description: Poll until the task reaches a terminal status.

name: remix_image
